UI window loop.description: A window and its frame loop (the loop ends when the window closes)

UI rectangle.description: A rectangle the window keeps: change its fields to move or recolor it

UI keys.description: Move while a key is held (Key is an enum: Key.Space, Key.A, Key.Left...)

UI pressed.description: Run once, on the frame the key goes down

UI onClose.description: Run when the window closes (the X, Esc or win.close())

UI onFocus.description: Run when the window gains the focus of the system

UI onBlur.description: Run when the window loses the focus of the system

UI onResize.description: Run with the new width and height when the user resizes the window

UI mouse.description: Run once, on the frame the mouse button goes down (Mouse: Left, Right, Middle)

UI text.description: A line of text the window keeps (scale 1 to 8; \n starts a new line; accents are in the font)

UI text wrap.description: Wrap a text to a width in pixels, and align its lines (Align: Left, Center, Right)
